title: abrahamaiproject-bit/billing-service
body:
# billing-service

Handles Lumen Freight subscription billing through Stripe: per-vehicle monthly pricing, invoicing, and dunning.

## Plans
- Starter: $29/vehicle/month
- Growth: $49/vehicle/month (includes live tracking)
- Enterprise: custom pricing
